status: DRAFT v1 by akiendell_cc_0, 2026-11-14, for casting by akienasus. Not cast. Build already exists: branch red3-remainder @ba8dc39a7 (one commit on fe0b6b541). Linux already reads it green (akiendelllinux, on fe0b6b541).
title: a proof that writes a plan fixture pins LF so the artifact door can reproduce its bytes
intention: test_a_hand_kick_back_writes_the_fixme_list writes its scratch ticket plan and node-class table with newline="\n", so the artifact door reproduces the plan's serialisation on every host and the fixme-list write lands.
why: Measured 2026-11-14 on Windows: Path.write_text in text mode translates \n to \r\n, so the fixture plan's bytes differ from what the door would serialise; emit's fixme-list write then goes through the door, which refuses the write (serialisation cannot be reproduced) and the hand kick-back proof reds on Windows only. Cause differs from red3 (a launch not handing over its ticket store); none of red3's clauses cover it.
traces_to: Law 3 (nothing known until measured: the proof must measure emit, not the host's newline), Law 8 (a proof must be the same proof on every box).
how: Add newline="\n" to the two write_text calls in _kick_back and _class_root. Red-first: run the unfixed proof on Windows (CRLF plan, door refusal), then fixed twice.

clauses.claim: over a scratch ticket store whose plan was written through the proof's writer, the plan's bytes contain no \r, so the door can reproduce its serialisation and the hand kick-back's fixme list lands on Windows and on Linux

decisions.text: D1: pin LF at the two write sites in this proof (plan, node-class copy). A shared scratch-fixture writer is NOT built here: the census (static upper bound 594 record-looking write_text plus 51 open_w across 193 files) is not a count of door hits, and building one door beneath 193 files is a separate decision for the orchestrator.

measured.saw: unfixed proof reds on Windows with the door's refusal of the fixme write (CRLF plan); with newline="\n" green twice; Linux green on fe0b6b541 per akiendelllinux
measured.how: bounded proof run on akiendell, branch red3-remainder @ba8dc39a7

watchme: none, because its proof cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_a_hand_kick_back_writes_the_fixme_list.py is the whole of its correctness
